title: 蒸気炉のぬくもりと、琥珀色の食卓
author: 久我山 灯子

en.title: The Warmth of the Steam Furnace and the Amber-Colored Table
en.premise: Estranged twin brothers return to their family home, which houses a "special steam-driven kitchen" left behind by their grandfather. Through the white steam rising from aged pipes and dishes prepared from inherited recipes, they begin to fill the void of the years spent apart. A story of slowly simmering and restoring the lost bonds of family.

zh.title: 蒸汽炉的温暖与琥珀色餐桌
zh.premise: 疏远的孪生兄弟回到了留有祖父遗留的“蒸汽驱动特殊厨房”的老家。伴随着从陈旧管道中升腾起的白色蒸汽，以及通过传承下来的食谱所烹饪出的料理，他们开始填补彼此间缺失的时光。这是一个如慢火炖煮般，重新找回失落家族羁绊的故事。
